name: nfcu_advanced_controls
default_exception_text: Any resource requiring an exception to this control must follow Navy Federal Credit Union's Document 2626.1, Security Issues and Exceptions Management Security Standard.
default_exception_bullets: Scope: Specific resource(s) and environment(s) covered by the exception.
Business Justification: Documented technical or operational reason the control cannot be applied.
Compensating Controls: Alternative detective, preventive, or governance controls that reduce the same risk.
Approvals: Sign-off from Security Architecture, the AI Risk Champion, and the accountable business owner.
Expiration: A defined end date for the exception, with renewal or closure required before expiry.
Monitoring: Ongoing review of the excepted resource and documented acknowledgement of any related alerts or findings.

foundry-guardrails.platforms: Microsoft Foundry, Azure Policy, Microsoft Sentinel
foundry-guardrails.mitre: ML Model Evasion, Prompt Injection, Inhibit Response Function
foundry-guardrails.owasp: LLM01: Prompt Injection, LLM07: Insecure Plugin Design
foundry-guardrails.regulatory: EU AI Act Article 9, NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.2, ISO/IEC 42001
foundry-guardrails.rationale: This is an advanced control because it governs model and agent safety settings at the platform layer and combines preventive policy enforcement with detective monitoring and compliance visibility.
capabilities: Mandates guardrail controls and policy compliance checks for model or agent deployments.
Collects compliance or activity signals into centralized monitoring workflows.
Provides an auditable path to detect exceptions, drift, or bypass attempts.

purview-dlp.platforms: Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft 365 Copilot
purview-dlp.owasp: LLM02: Sensitive Information Disclosure, LLM06: Excessive Agency
purview-dlp.regulatory: GLBA, PCI DSS, NIST AI RMF MAP/MEASURE, ISO/IEC 42001
purview-dlp.rationale: This is an advanced control because it combines data protection policy, audit telemetry, and downstream security operations monitoring across multiple Microsoft security services.
capabilities: Monitors sensitive data handling in Copilot interactions through Microsoft Purview.
Routes relevant audit and protection signals into Microsoft Sentinel for investigation.
Supports tuning, escalation, and evidentiary review for potential data leakage events.

copilot-audit.regulatory: NIST AI RMF GOVERN, SOC 2 CC7, ISO/IEC 42001

copilot-governance.platforms: Copilot Studio, Power Platform admin center, Microsoft Entra ID
copilot-governance.mitre: Privilege Misuse, Policy Evasion, Unauthorized Agent Operation
copilot-governance.owasp: LLM06: Excessive Agency, LLM07: Insecure Plugin Design
copilot-governance.regulatory: NIST AI RMF GOVERN, Zero Trust guidance, ISO/IEC 42001
copilot-governance.rationale: This is an advanced control because it constrains risky maker capabilities at the tenant and environment layers, where governance decisions directly shape downstream agent behavior.
capabilities: Restricts high-risk Copilot Studio or Power Platform capabilities at the environment or tenant layer.
Reduces the chance of unsafe publishing, data movement, or credential handling patterns.
Supports centralized governance decisions with enforceable platform settings.
